messages:
mira: quick sync — Acme AI asked for a dashboard + tracing hook to debug token-level errors in production. they want it before EOW next sprint. can we scope?
kevin: thanks. high level: dashboard (cost + error slices), trace hook (span + token metadata), and a sample-based error replay. tight but maybe MVP if we cut noncritical widgets.
ana: typo — i'm ana not nana :)
nana: (jk) i think MVP can be: a single error slice dashboard, trace hook that emits span id + error tags, and cost-per-slice card. defer fancy grouping/heatmaps.
jordan: agree. also need rollout criteria: 1) end-to-end tests for trace hook, 2) cost delta <5% on staging, 3) customer validation with 2 Acme users.
samira: FYI some customers care about token-level pii — need to confirm redaction rules before trace hook goes to prod. cc @kevin for KMS/HSM gating.
kevin: good call. add security check to rollout. i'll coordinate with security.
mira: propose acceptance checklist in PR:
```
- unit tests for hook logic
- integration test: generate error -> trace exists in console
- cost smoke: nightly run vs baseline
- customer signoff artifact: recording + checklist
```
kevin: can we make trace sampling configurable per-customer? Acme will want 100% for a week then 1% after.
jordan: yes, runtime config supports that. need UI toggle + api flag. for MVP, expose api flag only, UI later.
samira: cost impact estimate? 100% traces for a week on a mid-tier customer = ~12% token cost uplift (back-of-envelope). need to include in communication.
mira: okay action items: (1) kevin -> security + KMS check (2) jordan -> implement api flag + basic trace payload (3) ana -> dashboard mock + cost card (4) samira -> write redaction policy doc for hook.
nana: timeline?
kevin: i'll have security reply by Tue. jordan thinks api work is 3d, dashboard mock 2d. so earliest partial rollout next week if no blockers.
mira: let's keep launch minimal to reduce scope: no heatmaps, no drilldowns. single time-series + top 5 error slices.
jordan: during canary, ops-bot will post when sampling rate above 10%: "ops-bot: trace sampling high for Acme — watch costs". we should add automated alert if daily cost delta > 3%.
ops-bot: deploy-hook: canary started for trace-hook v0.3 on staging.
kevin: customer communication draft: short note explaining data collected, retention window (14 days), opt-out, and contact for issues. samira please review.
samira: will do. also suggest a small eval prompt set to validate quality regressions related to hooks.
mira: perfect. i'll create a tiny PR template for acceptance and schedule a 30m demo with Acme next Thu.
kevin: approved. :thumbsup:
jordan: logging note: include a compact binary token-id in spans not raw text. security happy path.
samira: +1.
mira: cool — closing thread. I'll post the checklist to the roadmap doc and link PRs.
kevin: thanks all.
